newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET SAYS WINS PATENT CASE VS BELOIT.
newsitem.headline: VALMET SAYS WINS PATENT CASE VS BELOIT.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Wednesday it had won a patent dispute case in the United States against Beloit Corporation, a unit of Harnischfeger Industries Inc.
"Valmet has been judged the winner in a lengthy patent dispute in the United States against Beloit Corporation," Valmet said in a statement.
Valmet mentioned no monetary award related to the ruling.
As a result of the ruling, Valmet is free in the United States to make, use and sell paper machines with dryer sections having alternate single tier drying groups with open draws, Valmet said.

Valmet brought the case against Beloit in 1992 seeking to invalidate two patents after Beloit threatened to sue it for patent infringement arising from the sale of a Valmet mini-mill to a U.S. customer, it said.
